name: 神兽OL
detailed_description:
Beast OL is a classic real-time turn based game. The game is set in a mythical era where the four major races of humans, immortals, demons, and ghosts coexist. There are eight advanced professions such as Vajra and Asura that interact and overcome each other.

The game system is complete, and the riding pet can ascend from Nirvana and merge with the rider to transform into a semi demon or semi god form. The real-time combat mode, on the other hand, makes PK pay more attention to the combination of skills and professions. In addition, there are also unique gameplay features such as maze dungeons, demon exposure, and legendary treasures.

Character walking: In the game screen, the character controlled by the player is located near the center of the screen.

When you need to move your position, left click on the desired location with the mouse.

You can also click the large map button in the upper left corner, click on the desired location, and the character will automatically find its way to that location.

When searching for task NPCs, you can click on the NPC name on the taskbar or task prompt, and the character will automatically find their way.

Item Bar: Left click on the item/prop on the right side of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"E") to open the item backpack.

Move the mouse over an item in the package and right-click to use it. Alternatively, you can drag items to the shortcut bar and use shortcut keys.

When using medicine, you can directly double-click the character's health bar or mana bar, and the medicine in the package will be automatically replenished.

Wearing equipment: Left click on the package at the bottom of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"E") to open the package. Move the mouse over a piece of equipment in the package, right-click on the equipment to wear it, and take it off in the same way.

Dialogue with NPC: Walk to the NPC, hover the mouse over the NPC, and click the left button to have a conversation with them.

Pet medication: Click on the pet on the right side of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"P"), right-click on the item to use, and then left click on the medication needed in the package again. You can also double-click the pet's health bar or mana bar directly, and it will automatically be filled with the medicine in the package.

Divine Beast Mount: Completing the pre mission of NPC "Yang Jian" will earn you a free divine beast egg suitable for your profession. Click on the "Nirvana Treasure Cauldron" in front of NPC "Yang Jian" to spawn a new divine beast. After the rebirth is completed, click on the divine beast on the right side of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"G") to call up the divine beast column, and click on the battle button to ride the divine beast.
